def submit_order(name, menu_choice, custom, meal_type, quantity, allergies):
    preference = custom.strip() if custom and custom.strip() else menu_choice
    price_per = MENU.get(menu_choice, {"price": 150})["price"]
    total_cost = price_per * quantity

    order = {
        "name": name or "Anonymous",
        "preference": preference,
        "meal_type": meal_type,
        "quantity": quantity,
        "allergies": allergies or "None",
        "price_per": price_per,
        "total_cost": total_cost
    }
    orders.append(order)

    status = f"""✅ **Order Submitted Successfully!**

**{name}** ordered **{preference}**
{meal_type} × {quantity}
**Total: KSh {total_cost}** (@ KSh {price_per} each)"""

    return status, get_full_summary(), MENU[menu_choice]["image"]

def get_full_summary():
    if not orders:
        return "**No orders submitted yet.**"
